glosses: An act of pointing out or indicating.

examples.text: The frequent stops they make in the most convenient places are plain indications of their weariness.

glosses: Any symptom or occurrence in a disease that serves to direct to suitable remedies; the problem that warrants and prompts the use of a diagnostic test, imaging mode, or treatment (e.g., medication, surgical procedure).

glosses: The act of instructing, teaching, or providing with information or knowledge.

examples.text: Students receive instruction in the arts and sciences.

Anstruther laughed good-naturedly. “[…] I shall take out half a dozen intelligent maistries from our Press and get them to give our villagers instruction when they begin work and when they are in the fields.”

examples.text: If my instructions may be your guide.

glosses: An order or command.

examples.text: Thus, when he drew up instructions in lawyer language, he expressed the important words by an initial, a medial, or a final consonant, and made scratches for all the words between; his clerks, however, understood him very well.

glosses: A set of directions provided by a manufacturer for the users of a product or service.

examples.text: I cannot act until I have taken instructions from my client.

examples.text: Les factionnaires se transmettent la consigne.

Le soldat des guerres de la Liberté attachait une importance presque supersti­tieuse à l’accomplissement des moindres consignes. De là résulte qu’il n'éprouvait aucune pitié pour les généraux ou les fonctionnaires qu’il voyait guillotiner après quelque défaite, sous l’inculpation de manquement à leur devoir.

glosses: Ordre, instruction que l’on donne à quelqu'un.

examples.text: Coup sur coup, à trois reprises, la vieille madame Rougon se présenta. Elle tempêtait au rez-de-chaussée, il l’entendait qui élevait la voix, s’irritant, voulant forcer la consigne.

examples.text: En 2019, les discussions autour de la loi antigaspillage pour une économie circulaire (Agec) ont été l’occasion de reparler de la consigne en France.
